name: data-runtime-sobject-helper-wave15-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises deterministic local SObject field-token, addError overload, and SObjectAccessDecision behavior only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

evidence.notes: Honors the explicit false enforceRootObjectCRUD argument locally.
Returns the one seeded Account record.
Records the one-argument object-level error message.
Records the object-level error with an explicit false escapeHtml flag.
Records a field-token error against the Name field.
Records a field-token error with an explicit false escapeHtml flag.
Reads a seeded value through a Schema.SObjectField token.
Writes non-default values through a Schema.SObjectField token and returns the previous value.
Reports token-field presence before and after a write.
Stores a non-default parent Account through the AccountId field token.

source.content: Account accessRecord = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Access'); List<Account> rows = new List<Account>{accessRecord}; SObjectAccessDecision decision = Security.stripInaccessible(AccessType.READABLE, rows, false); System.assertEquals(1, decision.getRecords().size()); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 Access', ((Account)decision.getRecords()[0]).Name); System.assertEquals(0, decision.getRemovedFields().size()); System.assertEquals(0, decision.getModifiedIndexes().size()); Schema.SObjectField nameField = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe().fields.getMap().get('Name'); Account account = new Account(); System.assertEquals(false, account.isSet(nameField)); System.assertEquals(null, account.get(nameField)); Object previous = account.put(nameField, 'Wave 15 Changed'); System.assertEquals(null, previous); System.assertEquals(true, account.isSet(nameField)); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 Changed', account.get(nameField)); previous = account.put(nameField, 'Wave 15 Final'); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 Changed', previous); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 Final', account.get(nameField)); Schema.SObjectField accountField = Contact.SObjectType.getDescribe().fields.getMap().get('AccountId'); Contact contact = new Contact(LastName = 'Wave 15 Child'); Account parent = new Account(Id = (Id)'001000000000015AAA', Name = 'Wave 15 Parent'); contact.putSObject(accountField, parent); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 Parent', contact.getSObject(accountField).get('Name')); Account objectError = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Object Error'); objectError.addError('Wave 15 object'); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 object', objectError.getErrors()[0].getMessage()); Account objectBoolError = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Object Bool'); objectBoolError.addError('Wave 15 object bool', false); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 object bool', objectBoolError.getErrors()[0].getMessage()); Account tokenError = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Token Error'); tokenError.addError(nameField, 'Wave 15 token'); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 token', tokenError.getErrors()[0].getMessage()); Account tokenEscapeError = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Token Escape'); tokenEscapeError.addError(nameField, 'Wave 15 token escape', false); System.assertEquals('Wave 15 token escape', tokenEscapeError.getErrors()[0].getMessage());
